verdict.rationale: Marlin runs a research job autonomously. After a brief scoping exchange, it works for up to about eight hours without further human input, and it can be cancelled mid-run. That covers long-running autonomous execution of a single task. However, the evidence only describes one-off research runs, not user-configured automations such as scheduled, recurring or event-triggered jobs, so it delivers only part of the story. Missing for 10: user-defined automation setup (scheduling, recurring or triggered runs), confirmation that runs continue in the background while the user is away or that the user is notified on completion, any API or programmatic way to launch runs (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
